verdict.rationale: Sentry's alerts documentation says an alert rule can "call webhooks" when issues or Monitors match pre-defined rules, so outbound webhook delivery exists. The evidence only shows webhooks as an action of alert rules, not as a general-purpose event subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: a dedicated webhook subscription feature for arbitrary event types, documented payload schemas, signature verification and retry semantics, API-driven webhook registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
